title: Pure Fluffal
summary: The Fluffal family only: Fluffal Fairies, Edge Imp Fiends and the Frightfur Fusions they become, plus Polymerization and staples. Fluffal Owl searches Polymerization, and Frightfur Patchwork adds an Edge Imp and a Polymerization. Fluffal Dog searches a Fluffal or Edge Imp Sabres. Toy Vendor discards to draw and searches when it leaves. Edge Imp Sabres revives itself, and Edge Imp Chain searches any Frightfur card when it goes to the GY. The 2020 cards lead. Edge Imp Scythe Fusion Summons a Frightfur during their Main Phase, and Fluffal Dolphin resets Toy Vendor. Frightfur Meister swaps a small Fluffal for a same-Level Fiend from the Deck. Frightfur Cruel Whale destroys a card on each field when summoned. Toy Parade, the newest card (2021), lets a DARK Fusion keep attacking.
main: Fluffal Owl
Searches Polymerization; Fusion Summons a Frightfur for 500 LP.
Edge Imp Sabres
Revives itself by putting a card from the hand on top of the Deck.
Fluffal Dolphin
Newest: Sets Toy Vendor from the GY and mills a Fluffal or Sabres.
Edge Imp Scythe
Newest: Fusion Summons a Frightfur on their Main Phase; protects one from the GY.
Frightfur Meister
Newest Scale 4: tributes a small Fluffal or Edge Imp for a same-Level Fiend.
Fluffal Dog
Searches a Fluffal or Edge Imp Sabres when summoned.
Edge Imp Chain
Searches any Frightfur card when sent to the GY.
Fluffal Penguin
Summons a Fluffal from the hand; draws two and discards one as Frightfur material.
Fluffal Octopus
Recovers a Fluffal or Edge Imp when summoned.
Fluffal Bear
Discards to Set Toy Vendor from the Deck; recovers Polymerization.
Fluffal Angel
Newest Scale 8: revives a Fluffal or Edge Imp; locks the Extra Deck to Fusions.
Toy Vendor
Discards to draw; searches a Fluffal or Sabres when it leaves.
Polymerization
Untagged Fusion Spell that Owl, Bear and Patchwork fetch.
Frightfur Patchwork
Searches an Edge Imp and Polymerization.
Frightfur Fusion
Fusion Summons by banishing materials from the field or GY.
Toy Parade
Newest: lets a DARK Fusion keep attacking; recovers a small DARK.
Frightfur Repair
Newest: returns a Frightfur to the Extra Deck and revives a Fluffal or Edge Imp.
extra: Newest Fusion: destroys a card on each field; pumps a Fusion.
Fusion: sends their monster to the GY; attacks twice.
Fusion over a Frightfur: revives one; can't be destroyed with three materials.
Fusion of an Edge Imp and two Fluffals: negates targeting.
Fusion: burns in battle and when it leaves.
Fusion: destroys a card per material.
Fusion from Edge Imp Chain: no responses in battle; revives itself.
Fusion from Sabres: attacks once per material.
Fusion of three Frightfurs: steals what it destroys.
Fusion from Sabres and Fluffal Bear: equips what it destroys.
